title: querystring is deprecated
summary: npm describes the querystring API as legacy and recommends URLSearchParams for new code.

constraints: Preserve percent encoding, repeated keys, empty values, ordering, array handling, and input coercion expected by callers.

steps.title: Replace querystring
steps.instructions: Translate parse and stringify usages to URLSearchParams and remove the querystring dependency.

steps.title: Verify query-string behavior
steps.instructions: Compare representative and malformed inputs, including repeated keys and non-ASCII values, before and after migration.

verification.purpose: Run query parsing, serialization, and repository tests.
